description: This file defines the PurgeCandidateAPI class which provides API endpoints for purging and listing candidates associated with specific job vacancies within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class includes functions for deleting candidate data for a vacancy, retrieving a list of purgeable candidates, and related validation rules.
